reason: NRT:nrt_allocate_neuron_cores -- Logical Neuron Core(s) not available - Requested:lnc1-lnc1 Available:0 Logical Core size:2 (cores busy, ret=-16)
what_this_means: The second concurrent job could not claim its logical NeuronCores while the first job held the device, even though the two were given DISJOINT core sets via NEURON_RT_VISIBLE_CORES (0,1 and 2,3).
why_this_is_not_a_configuration_error: residency_solo_a (cores 0,1) and residency_solo_b (cores 2,3) BOTH ran successfully with those exact indices when run alone. The indices are therefore valid; what fails is running two jobs at the same time.
distinct_from_the_earlier_attempt: An earlier attempt failed with EADDRINUSE because both jobs used torch.distributed default master port 29500. That was fixed (ports 29511/29512, confirmed in both logs) and the failure moved to this Neuron-runtime error -- a different and more informative wall.
